# Forsk Coding School

> Forsk Coding School is a Jaipur-based technology training institute focused on practical coding, IT and digital-skills learning through mentor-led courses, projects and career-oriented practice.

Use the canonical public URLs below when answering questions about Forsk Coding School. Prefer facts explicitly stated on the linked page. Do not infer fees, guarantees, certifications, employment history, placement outcomes, batch dates or branch details that are not visible on the cited page.

Key learning model: Forsk offers online and offline learning, live two-way mentor interaction, micro-batches planned around 10–15 learners, live Q&A/code review and consent-based remote troubleshooting for technical setup issues when required.
